controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Galileo clear and green-filter images registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Bounded correction and brightness matching reduce photographed shading; raw detector brightness is not calibrated albedo. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. Resolved detail ranges from about 2.4 to 8.3 km per source pixel.
controls.title: SSI mosaic
controls.summary: Surface brightness is adjusted to reduce photographed shading. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing or unreliable images.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above an 83.5 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Voyager-derived shape model. This shows the large irregular shape, not surveyed local topography. The 5° grid includes modeled unseen terrain; the archive warns that facets and depressions may be exaggerated.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Height from a Voyager model, relative to an 83.5 km sphere. Unseen terrain and small features are uncertain.
